_note: Standalone simulation config. watchlist "all" scans every ticker in the Massive whole-market cache (universe_filters sets tradeability floors; zero them to scan literally everything). Requires data_source massive + backfilled cache. Swap watchlist back to an explicit list for yahoo/alpaca.
_note_data_source: Enum: yahoo | alpaca | massive | kalshi | polymarket. kalshi/polymarket score IMPLIED-PROBABILITY bars ([0,1] daily closes) through the same engine — watchlist entries become "SERIES/MARKET" tickers (kalshi) or market slugs (polymarket), SPY regime anchor stays on Yahoo, and prediction_markets below configures the external gating legs. Polymarket bars have volume=0: cut VOL legs via legMask.

external_gates._note: External-leg gates applied by gates.GateBook in the backtest loop, never inside indicators.py. GateBook currently wires av_earnings_sue + macro_flags only; kalshi/polymarket blocks below are config stubs (enabled:false) and are NOT applied by GateBook yet. mode 'annotate' adds sue/sue_pct/macro_risk_on columns to every trade (slice post-hoc in ablation/MC); 'filter' additionally drops non-passing trades (live-representative; sue 'na' and macro '' drop too). SUE backtests read av_cache/ only — backfill deliberately: py -m rhengine.gates backfill.

av_earnings_sue._source_note: source: 'av' = AlphaVantage deep retroactive history (30y, 25 req/DAY, backfill via py -m rhengine.backfill) for backtests TODAY; 'finnhub' = the forward-accumulated bulk-calendar store (report-dated, whole market, grows daily via the scheduled snapshot) — use once enough window has accumulated, or for the live path.

costs._note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transaction costs (rhengine/costs.py). Every CLI's --cost-bps now defaults to None and resolves here; passing --cost-bps still overrides. Set 2026-07-24 by audit FC-2: the eleven CLIs previously carried their own defaults (0.0 in backtest/portfolio/optimize/nulltest/montecarlo/ic, 5.0 elsewhere) and tests/results/current_full.csv was forensically confirmed generated at 0 bps.
costs._calibration_note: 30 bps, NOT 5. universe_filters.min_dollar_volume is 500,000, i.e. names trading $500k/day, where round-trip half-spread x2 + impact is routinely 30-100+ bps. 5 bps is a mega-cap number applied to a microcap universe. Measured breakeven on current_full.csv is 11.2 bps incremental: at +5 bps mean R falls +0.0572 -> +0.0316, at +10 bps -> +0.0061, at +20 bps -> -0.0450. Lower this only with executed-fill evidence.

execution._note: Module 7 execution gates (rhengine/execution.py), adopted 2026-07-30 from docs/AGENT-SPEC.md. LIVE PATH ONLY — daily bars carry no bid/ask, so this gate cannot be applied retrospectively and changes NO recorded backtest result. Do not synthesise a spread to make it apply: Corwin-Schultz was validated 2026-07-25 and rejected at ~37x too high (costs.estimate_round_trip_bps).
execution._units_note: spread_gate_pct is the quoted spread as a fraction of mid, which IS the ROUND-TRIP cost (each crossing pays a half-spread, twice = one spread). Round-trip bps = pct x 10000, NO factor of 2. So 0.01 admits 100 bps round trip in spread alone — ~3x the 33 bps that erases the gross edge, and almost exactly the worst measured ADV decile (98.1 bps). 0.01 is the SOURCE default, kept because this repo does not silently retune source parameters.
execution._binds_note: MEASURED 2026-07-30 against both stratified quote captures: this gate rejects ~48% of the least-liquid ADV decile (14/29 names on both days), part of deciles 1-2, and nothing above ~$6M/day. universe_filters.min_dollar_volume = 500,000 does NOT imply a sub-1% spread. Reproduce with: py scripts/rh_spreads.py gate

strategy._pead_note: PEAD earnings-drift sleeve, pooled alongside the regime strategy (backtest.py, regime-precedence per bar; legMask=3=EVENT+DRIFT). DISABLED 2026-07-21: it tested +0.15R OOS on a universe INCLUDING biotech, but on the biotech-EXCLUDED universe (the hard rule) it is -0.05R/PF 0.89/-186 R — its edge lived in the banned names. Re-enable only if biotech is allowed back. Pooling code retained.
strategy._thresholds_note: Ablation cuts 2026-07-18 (docs/notebooklm-findings.md 4.1): residualmomentum trades its primary RA-RES leg alone (confirmations are OOS drag, t=-3.5 for the full set vs +8.9 primary-only); macd reduced to CROSS+SUB-0 (OOS PF 1.37). Spec defaults stay legMask=0; the cut lives in this config. Bollinger keeps all 4 legs (only OOS-positive config in choppy). All three sleeves were retired 2026-10-02; the masks stay so a --strategy reproduction still matches the run that rejected them.

exits._DEAD_KEYS_note: stop_atr_mult and target_atr_mult below are READ BY NOTHING (verified 2026-07-31 by grep across rhengine/ and scripts/; only tests/test_sim.py mentions them, in a fixture it builds itself). The live stop/target multiples come from the SETUP, i.e. rhengine/strategies.json thresholds stopAtrMult/targetAtrMult, overridable per strategy through config.json strategy.thresholds.<strategy>. Editing the two keys below looks like retuning the exit and silently does nothing — that is why an exit sweep appeared to show 'no effect' until 2026-07-31. Left in place rather than deleted so this note has something to point at; the keys that DO bind in this block are trail_trigger_mult, chandelier_atr_mult, max_hold_sessions, min_stop_pct and winsor_r_cap.
exits._min_stop_pct_note: Skip setups whose ATR stop is under this fraction of entry. Raised 0.003->0.0075 2026-07-20: near-zero-ATR names (low-vol equities, closed-end funds like CEE) produced degenerate R (0.3% stop -> a normal move = +27R) that failed the sanity degenerate_r check. 0.75% is still tight but noise-survivable.
exits._winsor_r_cap_note: Cap the recorded UPSIDE r_multiple of a trade at this value (downside left uncapped so the loss tail stays honest). A gap-through-target that fills far above target can book +20-36R once, but that windfall isn't repeatable/bankable for expectancy or Monte Carlo — capping it keeps rare gaps from flattering the book. Set 0/remove to disable. 2026-07-21.

universe_filters._exclude_etfs_note: Drop US-listed ETFs from the equity scan (universe_hygiene blocklist; refresh via `py -m rhengine.universe_hygiene refresh`). Whole-market backtest: ETFs were ~33% of trades and -6,551 R (bond/credit/covered-call ETFs have near-zero ATR, so pennies-wide stops get noise-stopped for -1R). Clean-equity book is +6,178 R vs -1,712 R with ETFs mixed in. Set false to revert.
universe_filters._exclude_adr_biotech_note: Hard rule: no small ADRs and no biotech. exclude_adr drops foreign-domiciled (country != US) names UNDER adr_smallcap_max_mktcap ($M) so liquid large-cap foreign (ACN/ACGL/AEM/ALC) survive — the narrow 'no ADR' reading chosen 2026-07-21. exclude_biotech drops Biotechnology (any cap) + small-cap clinical Pharma/Health under biotech_smallcap_max_mktcap. Binary trial/FDA/earnings events = unpredictable two-sided gap risk. Note these names were net +profit in this window (fat right tails) so the rule COSTS ~3,700 backtested R for lower tail risk. Uses sector_map cache (`py -m rhengine.universe_hygiene sectors tests/results/current_full.csv`); unknown names pass through. Set false to revert.
